title: Build the consultant-relay allow rule, scoped to one named PR and the exact act, with the owner's words quoted.
ruling: Owner at 11:29 CST Nov 15, via the consultant (relayed by the coordinator at 11:32 CST; not read by triage). The consultant's question was "Relayed yes for the safety check"; the owner's words as the consultant relayed them, verbatim: "a". Option a: build the consultant-relay allow rule (branch allow-consultant-relayed-yes, runner 12's builder), scoped to one named PR and the exact act, his words quoted. It overturns the page-only part of decision relayed-grant-read-from-page for consultant relays (a relay counts only when the receiver reads the owner's pick from the page). Guard change: it is reviewed. The consultant's caveats: that guard and owner-override already cover this case, and the consultant's box lacked the widening label. Covers that build and that rule only. PR 3510 holds the build.
source: Coordinator message 11:32 CST Nov 15 relaying the consultant (relayed, not read by triage); the owner's typed words were not seen by triage.
